description: Shared enum definitions used only by Operations-domain components (never Investments or Dynamics). Domain-agnostic shared types remain in Core/common.json.

VSCACControlModes.description: AC-side control mode of a voltage-source-converter (VSC) terminal. AC_REACTIVE_POWER: converter controls reactive power / fixed power factor. AC_VOLTAGE: converter controls the AC-side voltage magnitude.
VSCACControlModes.title: VSCACControlModes

VSCDCControlModes.description: DC-side control mode of a voltage-source-converter (VSC) terminal. DC_POWER: converter controls active power transferred to the DC side. DC_VOLTAGE: converter controls the DC-side voltage. DC_VOLTAGE_DROOP: P-Vdc droop, V_dc = dc_setpoint - droop_gain * P_c.
VSCDCControlModes.title: VSCDCControlModes

VoltageUnitBasis.description: Unit basis a voltage setpoint is stored in. SYSTEM_BASE: per-unit on the bus base voltage (PSS/E RAW native for FACTS VSET). NATURAL_UNITS: kilovolts.
VoltageUnitBasis.title: VoltageUnitBasis
